label: The connected journey
narration: From the first client request to the final field report, T H B S Field Assist brings people, work, and evidence into one connected journey.

label: Client to assignment
narration: Sales creates the client and routes the work to a squad. The team lead assigns an engineer, with a clear brief, priority, and due date. Named boards keep delivery organised.

label: The engineer workspace
narration: The engineer sees their own assignments in the app, accepts the visit, or declines with a reason. The dashboard shows that response, so everyone knows who owns the next step.

label: Site time and location
narration: At the site, the engineer checks in, records breaks, and checks out. Arrival and departure location snapshots give the team lead context for time spent on the visit.

label: Scan cable details
narration: Scan the cable or drum label to extract its printed identifiers. Review and correct the suggested values before applying them to the report. Manual entry is always available.

label: Guided voice reporting
narration: The voice assistant speaks first and guides the engineer through relevant questions. Valid answers save into the form on the device. Local voice and label recognition work offline after initial setup.

label: Offline to received
narration: Drafts stay encrypted on the device. Review and confirm with location to queue the report. When the server is reachable and the app is open and unlocked, delivery retries and returns a receipt.

label: Ask the right person
narration: Need help on site? Find a colleague with fuzzy search, see their department and lead, and open a direct or squad conversation. Engineers and team leads can reply across the app and dashboard.

label: Evidence to approval
narration: A received report is ready for human review. The supervisor inspects the original answers and location, approves the work, or requests follow up. Asset history connects each visit and decision.

label: AI for operations
narration: Dashboard A I summarises priorities, drafts visit instructions, and highlights gaps in report evidence, with links to source records. People review the suggestions and keep control of every operational decision.

label: People and permissions
narration: An organisation view makes departments, squads, and reporting lines easy to understand. Role based access gives Sales, team leads, engineers, and administrators the information and actions appropriate to their work.

label: Built around field work
narration: Reusable forms, client boards, assignment alerts, editable profiles, and light and dark themes bring the experience together. One workflow connects field capture with operational visibility.

label: THBS Field Assist
narration: T H B S Field Assist. Clear ownership. Connected teams. Field evidence you can follow from capture to review.
